mapper.select: SELECT a.asset_id as assetId, a.name as name, a.category as category FROM asset a WHERE a.expected_maintenance_date <= SYSDATE + INTERVAL '5' DAY AND a.status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'USING') AND a.is_deleted = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alarm al WHERE al.asset_id = a.asset_id AND al.type = 'ASSET_REGULAR_MAINTENANCE' AND al.is_deleted = 'N' AND TO_CHAR(al.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )
mapper.update: UPDATE asset SET status = 'MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED', updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT p.part_id as partId, p.name as name, p.asset_id as assetId FROM part p WHERE p.expected_maintenance_date <= SYSDATE + INTERVAL '5' DAY AND p.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND p.is_deleted = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alarm al WHERE al.asset_id = p.asset_id AND al.type = 'PART_REGULAR_REPLACE' AND al.is_deleted = 'N' AND TO_CHAR(al.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )
mapper.update: UPDATE part SET status = 'UNAVAILABLE', updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE part_id = #{partId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id as reservationId, r.asset_id as assetId FROM reservation r WHERE r.end_time <= SYSDATE - INTERVAL '20' DAY AND r.status = 'APPROVED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alarm al WHERE al.asset_id = r.asset_id AND al.type = 'RESERVATION_OVERDUE' AND al.is_deleted = 'N' AND al.description LIKE '%' || r.reservation_id || '%' )

SELECT m.maintenance_id as maintenanceId, m.asset_id as assetId, a.name as assetName, a.category as assetCategory FROM maintenance m JOIN asset a ON m.asset_id = a.asset_id WHERE m.created_at <= SYSDATE - INTERVAL '30' DAY AND m.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND m.is_deleted = 'N' AND a.is_deleted = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alarm al WHERE al.asset_id = m.asset_id AND al.type = 'ASSET_MAINTENANCE_LEAVED' AND al.is_deleted = 'N' AND al.description LIKE '%' || m.maintenance_id || '%' )
